home.tagline: A cozy little corner to shape clay, no rush.
home.note: No score, no timer, no mistakes.

hint.cutDesktop: Drag the wire along the block to choose the amount
hint.cutTouch: Slide your finger along the block to choose the amount
hint.throwDesktop: Click, pull up and let go to throw
hint.throwDone: No more bubbles! Time for the rolling pin
hint.rollDesktop: Drag back and forth to roll the clay
hint.rollTouch: Drag back and forth to roll the clay
hint.foldDesktop: Double-click to fold the clay in half
hint.foldTouch: Double-tap to fold the clay in half

hint.stoppedDesktop: Hold SPACE to spin the wheel
hint.stoppedTouch: Slide the pedal up to spin the wheel
hint.sideDesktop: Hover the side to thin · click and drag to widen
hint.sideTouch: Slide one finger on the side to thin · two fingers widen
hint.topDesktop: Drag the top to stretch or flatten · click the top to open it
hint.topTouch: Drag the top to stretch · tap the top to open it
hint.spongeDesktop: Hold the click on the piece to wet the clay
hint.spongeTouch: Hold your finger on the piece to wet the clay
hint.spongeEmptyDesktop: The sponge is dry: press E or click the bucket to wet it again
hint.spongeEmptyTouch: The sponge is dry: tap the sponge to wet it again
hint.dryingDesktop: The clay is turning dull: press E to grab the sponge
hint.dryingTouch: The clay is turning dull: tap the sponge

hint.pickDesktop: Pick the ribber or a handle from the bar
hint.pickTouch: Pick the ribber or a handle from the bar
hint.ribStoppedDesktop: Hold SPACE to spin the wheel and hold the click on the side to rib
hint.ribStoppedTouch: Spin the wheel with the pedal and hold your finger on the side to rib
hint.ribDesktop: Hold the click on the side of the piece to carve grooves
hint.ribTouch: Hold your finger on the side of the piece to carve grooves
hint.placeDesktop: Click the side of the piece to attach the handle
hint.placeTouch: Tap the side of the piece to attach the handle
hint.adjustDesktop: Drag the dots to adjust the handle
hint.adjustTouch: Drag the dots to adjust the handle
hint.fluteDesktop: Click the side to carve the flutes · click again to remove them
hint.fluteTouch: Tap the side to carve the flutes · tap again to remove them
hint.holeDesktop: Click the side of the piece to cut a little hole
hint.holeTouch: Tap the side of the piece to cut a little hole

toast.locked: This handle is in the shop
toast.maxHandles: This piece already has plenty of handles
toast.jointCrack: The piece was dry: the joint got a little crack
toast.ribNeedsSpin: The ribber needs the wheel spinning
toast.maxHoles: This piece already has plenty of holes

wheel.label: Wheel
wheel.pedalHint: Wheel pedal: slide up to spin faster

painting.glazeHint: Colors get brighter after the kiln

toast.bandsNeedSpin: Spin the wheel to make bands

confirm.title: Back to shaping?
confirm.body: This piece's painting will be erased.

kiln.title: Which finish do you like?
kiln.subtitle: The preview shows the effect. The final colors appear when the piece leaves the kiln.
kiln.subtitleShort: Final colors appear when the piece leaves the kiln.
